"MichaeLA" is a discussion about the people and the passion that drive the most popular headlines of the day. It has an upbeat vibe with issue-driven conversations, lively guests, and breaking news, hosted by Michaela Pereira. The show airs live from CNN's Los Angeles bureau each weekday afternoon. Pereira is a former co-host of CNN's "New Day."
